## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The refresh helper should be fixed because it allows hand-edited tracked files to pass verification.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register unlisted files, plus tests for manifest updates and preservation of existing digests.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing digests during refresh — When a tracked file is edited and included in `names`, refreshing replaces its original digest and makes `verify` accept the edit. The assignment unconditionally overwrites existing entries; the refresh test exercises only unchanged tracked content. — Refreshing after adding files can erase evidence of hand edits, defeating the integrity protection described in the pull request.
